_doc: Shared configuration for the non-urgent AI slots. No secrets here. Copy to config.json and edit.

window._doc: start_hour/end_hour in local time; days = 'any' or '1,2,3,4,5' (Monday=1)

_agents_doc: binary = the Hermes binary of the profile. wf_home = WF_HOME of the queue client (its own identity, hence its own write roots); null = shared client config. check_free=false if this agent's model does not run on the local GPU. enabled=false = the tick launches nothing, even if the cron job exists.
